[b]Elections ---[/b]

[i] For the last 50 years, New Arenenge has had a communist government under a socialist economy. This year, 2026, elections are being held for the president. According to the constitution, the government may be situated in any ideology and/or economy as long as the people can elect the government members, including the president, the local, and the state representatives. This may not seem like much for the average person, until you realize Arenenge is THE top producer of processed steel and has one of the biggest navy in Erene. Still, this may not be shocking, as for the past fifty or so years this has not been a problem. But in the early twenty first century, the people of New Arenenge have expressed their concerns for Arenenges failing economy, and their visible lagging behind in technology. The Freedom & Democracy party, and the Liberal Socialists party are the 3rd and 2nd most popular parties in all of Arenenge. Only one party will inevitably rise to power and change Arenenge for the better, or worse. 

Though, these presidential elections aren't just different because the next president might be able to change the government itself, no. Today, New Arenenge ranks 6th in the Most Influenced Nation In Erene index (I totally made that up) which is concerning. Why? Well, if Arenenge is heavily influenced by other nations, those other nations are going to influence Arenenges politics. According to the 2021 study made by Arevard University, the last presidential elections were influenced by the media and funds a lot. About 12% of the voters didnt truly know why they voted for the president. And about 5% of the voters were paid to vote. Yes. Paid to vote. Now, the government is cracking down on corruption, by adding social media blocks- wait, social media blocks. Yes, the Arenese government has made changes to how social media apps, mainly Twitting and Instant-o-gram censor or block content. This is only adding fuel to the fire. [/i]

[b]International Diplomacy ---[/b]

[i]The current cabinet of Arenenge, nearing its end, are taking international measures to ensure that New Arenenge will be ready for its next cabinet. A start to this is their recent kindling of relations between the formerly isolationist nation of Pantagruel, Daesun. The Arenese government seeks to trade with them and form close relations. The Thyven-Hydronia Economic Pact, or THEP has not directly responded to Arenenge, the security council head, about this. Though Vespurias, who is currently in a magical fight, has commented on Arenenges attempt at friendship with Daesun. This is an issue because Daesun has blatantly attacked THEP through a proxy war in Astanir, and has called them out on social media. THEP, the defensive and economic alliance, is allegedly communicating with Arenenges government as I write this. 

Speaking of an alliance, Arenenge has reportedly been trying to gain members for a new alliance called the Common Peoples Alliance, or CPA for short. This alliance welcomes communists, socialists, and social democratic people/nations alike. They currently have an unofficial count of  4 nations, but are allegedly going up in numbers. This alliance is a defensive alliance aimed to combat corrupt people and nations around Erene. They promote diplomacy as a way to do this, and dislike war. And through diplomacy they will save Erene

In another alliance, the International Alliance, a new council member has replaced one other. Daesun, has been in Bravanors place since a couple months ago, along with Vespurias, New Arenenge, Neue Republik, Jomsland, and United Hydronia. THEP was very alarmed when the vote was sent, but neither UNH or VES attempted to veto the vote. At last the vote went though, and Daesun was granted special permissions. This is history changing, since Daesun is the first Big Six Council member to have a drastically low military spending, and ZERO nuclear stockpile. The nations of BR. Bob, United Hydronia, Dhornaper, New Balion, and a couple others have been affected by their censorship. The images used in the IA website somehow no longer work! The IA cyber workers are working on it, but have no idea why this has happened. 

The current members of the IA, excluding New Arenenge are completely lazy and incompetent." Says the Arenese government. All they do is complain about how the IA doesn't do stuff, then continues to not do anything in the IA. They are incompetent hypocrites whos only narrative is to do nothing and expect to win. The Arenese Ministry of Education, and Ministry of Foreign affairs agree. Stating that their past sessions and meetings with the more powerful nations prove to be fruitless. They, mostly the members of THEP and the EDU have submitted 0 news reports over the last three decades, have not attended any meetings, and have not submitted IGSC resolutions. But one thing they did do is complain and complain about how the IA is lazy, unimportant, useless, and incompetent. One thing I can say about them is that they are hypocrites. Hypocrites to the very core. Their foreign affairs are only filled with love letters from the enemy nation, and memes from the internet. They dont dare to get involved with other work. The reason they are so busy is because they are fighting each other instead of looking outward at the world.

The government of New Arenenge has sent a request to the Socialist government of Astanir to provide military and economic support after the war. The request says that Arenenge will provide gold and mints to Astanir, and that Mints may become a usable currency strictly for civilian needs. The request also says that Astanir will be independent and join the Common Peoples Alliance. This request was sent last week, and will be enacted when the war is formally over.
[/i]
[b]Arenenge ---[/b]

[i]Arenenge, the nation that produces the MOST processed iron out of any other nation in Erene- Hey, that's it! With about ~320 steel mills, and 18 ports specifically for exporting processed iron, or importing iron ore, they stand alone as the iron nation. This has slowed down recently, but Arenenge still proves to be the worlds leading processed iron producer. Arenenge is attempting to shift its focus away from the processed iron field to the computing field. ASML, (Arenese Superconducting Material Lithography), is Erenes 2nd largest photolithography machine manufacturer out of two, with a whopping 13 billion income, and 25 billion in revenue. Recently, the Arenese government has supplied ASML steel and iron at half price, greatly boosting ASMLs production. Because of Arenenges laws, ASML is free to trade with anyone they want, except if that anyone has been sanctioned by New Arenenge, or in other scenarios. Because of the special demand of Lithography machines from ASML,  today their income is about 13 billion and currently up to trade with anyone. 

Arenenge is showing significant military progress, including finally promising to show their full military assets within the next elections after this one. Will this change after elections? No one knows, but one thing we do know, is that Arenenge is estimated to have one of the biggest navies in Erene, with over 150 warships and over 10 more being planned. The exact number is sadly classified.

Another great military advancement made by Arenenge is their strategic control over some minor island west of their mainland. To project their influence greater, they have decided to take very small, and minor islands. These islands that are west of Arenenge have little to no population and wont be of any burden to Arenenge. Though according to the IA, Arenenge will get much for exclusive sea zone territory. This will bring in much more money, as they gain access to more resources, control of trading routes, and most importantly, allow Arenenges influence to spread. The islands were checked for indigenous population so they could be admitted into the IOIP (International Overview of Indigenous Populations) and gained two. The Nu tribe, and the Nmoo tribe. Both small tribes that has gotten to the stage of stone spears, axes, and stable houses. They both spoke the same language, Kintu, which is a minor regional language located in East Arenenge. They also have claimed a new society of people have been found, claiming that they look like people who used to be apart of modern civilization until it fell. Large buildings, ruins, glass, and gunpowder have been found. Arenenge says this might be a past colony from the Gendarmite Empire that ruled those lands a couple centuries ago.

Arenenge is currently not responding to the many international threats and wars outside of Arezhou. They stand isolated from  the rest of the world, focusing on Arezhou, and Arezhou only. The president said that they would stay like this until elections, when the new government of Arenenge emerges. This, however, is bad news for the world. Arenenge is a head of the security council in THEP, and is also the world's biggest military power. What will this isolationist policy do? What will Erene do? Well, under Arenenges isolation, a new democratic alliance has been made. The EDU has also declared war on THEP. The IASC became divided. The world of Erene has become that much more unstable. Arenenges isolation will only destabilize Erene further. 

Speaking of Erene, multiple events regarding the white straight have occurred. Thyven has become communist, to which the Arenese government has proved to be fond of. Tallisland continues to be a warzone, with no sign of IA help. Vespurias, rebuilding from the outbreak of magic, has found a new government. The most capitalist of capitalists. Arenenge has on the record been stating they are to be cooped with a new, unified and poverty free government. THEP and the IA have dismissed this as jokes, rumors, and just that angry denial of something bad. Though Arenenge has reportedly been staying true to this word, as more messages from the government has come out. 

A new capitalist mayor has been elected in Foreston City, which sparked outrage from the media. Zoshia Manchu is the female capitalist mayor of Foreston, who promises to heavily lower taxes, fund the police, bring people out of poverty, and more. Some people say this is impossible. Others say he wont make it. Though he seems to be doing just that. ABN (Arenese Broadcasting Networks) say Zoshia is lowering taxes, and he has lowered taxes by 10% in his first month alone. He also has begun to fund the police force, lowering crime by another 10%. Some people are changing their minds about her, and some people double down on their word, calling it a bluff from her cabinet.[/i] [/spoiler]

[quote=pantagruel;60813810][spoiler= illegal post][b]DAESUN SEIZES VALDDERAN ISLANDS[/b]

[i]After hours of brutal fighting the Daesunite Ministry of Defence is proud to announce the capture of the Northern and Southern Valdderan archipelago. All Valdderan military contest has completely annihilated and the islands are pacified. The islands have been designated with codenames operating by Occupied Security Zones(OSZ's), with their names being OSZ-1, OSZ-2, OSZ-3, OSZ-4, and OSZ-5. Daesun seeks to integrate and incorporate these islands into the United Daesunite Federation (UDF), justifying action via historical claims, large Daesunite population, economic, and political ties to the islands. While strategically valuable, the islands are still too unpopulated for statehood, and therefore will be designated as overseas territories until they reach suffice-able population.

Daesun also looks towards beginning the Jorge initiative, an economic revitalization plan fixed on restoring the resource industries of the islands. Daesun seeks to flood the islands with government subsidies to companies willing to invest into their development. Companies who are able to develop assets within the islands the most will recieve highest incentive, creating a perfect environment for competition and rapid growth. 

But Daesun wouldn't seek to seize the islands without the word of the people, as that went against every core value that she held dearly. A series of referendums were held all across each OSZs, each to be free and fair without the use of fear or intimidation. The referendum's prompt was simple, "Do you wish for your OSZ to join the Daesunite Federation?", yet it sent shockwaves. Daesun secured a desisive victory in all OSZs, primarily due to civil discontent with the Valdderan government's expensive and bloody intervention into Tirakan. The results of the referendums were as follows...

OSZ-1: 64.3% Aye, 28.9% Nay, 6.8% Neutral

OSZ-2: 86.4% Aye, 11.2% Nay, 2.4% Neutral

OSZ-3: 91.5% Aye, 4.2% Nay, 4.3% Neutral

OSZ-4: 54.2% Aye, 41.7% Nay, 4.1% Neutral

OSZ-5: 77.2% Aye, 22.1% Nay 0.7% Neutral

With the referendums done, each territory would be processed for incorporation, with actual territory-hood estimated to begin in mid 2027.
[/i]
